description.en: An experimental map, not an agreed curriculum. The 2016 article supplies historical topics; stage placement, dependencies and assessment examples are proposals. Theory and Engineering are views of one graph, with shared node identities.
description.zh-CN: 这是一张供讨论的实验性地图，并非已确定的课程。2016 年文章提供历史主题；阶段划分、依赖关系和考核示例均为提案。理论与工程是同一图谱的不同视图，共享节点保持同一身份。

title.en: Robotics Engineer Learning Plan — YY硕, 2016-09-08 (archived article)
title.zh-CN: 机器人工程师学习计划 — YY硕，2016-09-08（文章存档）

title.en: Issue #1 — a robotics tech tree for people and agents
title.zh-CN: Issue #1 — 面向人和 Agent 的机器人科技树

description.en: Mathematical language and tools for building.
description.zh-CN: 建立数学语言与动手工具。

description.en: Describe, measure and control physical systems.
description.zh-CN: 描述、测量并控制物理系统。

description.en: Turn observations and models into useful actions.
description.zh-CN: 把观测与模型转化为有效行动。

description.en: Combine capabilities and explain what works.
description.zh-CN: 组合各项能力，并说明有效性的依据。

summary.en: Use vectors and matrices to represent geometry and solve systems.
summary.zh-CN: 用向量与矩阵表达几何关系并求解方程组。

outcomes.en: Solve a small linear system and explain the residual.
outcomes.zh-CN: 求解一个小型线性方程组并解释残差。

evidence.en: A worked derivation and a numerical check of the same system.
evidence.zh-CN: 同一方程组的推导过程与数值检验。

summary.en: Describe changing quantities and uncertainty in measurements.
summary.zh-CN: 描述随时间变化的量与测量中的不确定性。

outcomes.en: Model a changing signal and estimate the spread of noisy observations.
outcomes.zh-CN: 对变化信号建模，并估计含噪观测的离散程度。

evidence.en: A signal plot with derivatives, sample statistics and stated assumptions.
evidence.zh-CN: 包含导数、样本统计量和假设说明的信号图。

summary.en: Translate small mathematical models into inspectable Python or C++ programs.
summary.zh-CN: 将小型数学模型转化为可检查的 Python 或 C++ 程序。

outcomes.en: Implement a matrix calculation and diagnose a numerical error.
outcomes.zh-CN: 实现矩阵计算，并诊断一个数值误差问题。

evidence.en: Runnable code, a reference result and a short error analysis.
evidence.zh-CN: 可运行代码、参考结果及简短的误差分析。

summary.en: Build, version and inspect programs in a reproducible workspace.
summary.zh-CN: 在可复现的工作环境中构建、管理并检查程序。

outcomes.en: Build a small project from a clean checkout and inspect a failure.
outcomes.zh-CN: 从干净的仓库检出构建小项目，并排查一次失败。

evidence.en: A repository with build instructions and a recorded debugging session.
evidence.zh-CN: 包含构建说明与调试记录的代码仓库。

summary.en: Connect a sensor and understand its signals, units and interface.
summary.zh-CN: 连接传感器，并理解其信号、单位和接口。

outcomes.en: Read a sensor and distinguish raw values from calibrated measurements.
outcomes.zh-CN: 读取传感器，并区分原始数值与校准后的测量值。

evidence.en: A wiring diagram and a measurement log with units and calibration notes.
evidence.zh-CN: 接线图，以及带单位和校准说明的测量日志。

summary.en: Relate forces, motion and inertia in a simple robot mechanism.
summary.zh-CN: 在简单机器人机构中建立力、运动与惯量的关系。

outcomes.en: Derive a simple mechanism model and state the neglected effects.
outcomes.zh-CN: 推导简单机构的模型，并说明忽略的效应。

evidence.en: A free-body diagram, equations and comparison with a measured motion.
evidence.zh-CN: 受力图、方程，以及与实测运动的比较。

summary.en: Use a plant model and measurements to reason about closed-loop behavior.
summary.zh-CN: 利用被控对象模型与测量来分析闭环行为。

outcomes.en: Explain how a controller changes tracking error and disturbance response.
outcomes.zh-CN: 解释控制器如何改变跟踪误差和扰动响应。

evidence.en: Step-response plots and a justified controller choice.
evidence.zh-CN: 阶跃响应曲线与控制器选型依据。

summary.en: Connect geometric transformations to the frames used by sensors and robots.
summary.zh-CN: 将几何变换与传感器、机器人使用的坐标系联系起来。

outcomes.en: Transform a point between two frames and check the inverse transformation.
outcomes.zh-CN: 在两个坐标系间变换一个点，并检验逆变换。

evidence.en: An annotated frame diagram and a round-trip transformation check.
evidence.zh-CN: 标注清楚的坐标系示意图与往返变换检验。

summary.en: Connect load paths and stress concentration to a mechanical design decision.
summary.zh-CN: 将载荷传递路径和应力集中与机械设计决策联系起来。

outcomes.en: Compare a simple stress estimate with a model and explain their assumptions.
outcomes.zh-CN: 比较简单应力估算与模型结果，并解释各自的假设。

evidence.en: A load-case sketch and stress comparison with boundary conditions stated.
evidence.zh-CN: 载荷工况草图，以及注明边界条件的应力比较。

summary.en: Represent a buildable part with dimensions, materials and assembly intent.
summary.zh-CN: 用尺寸、材料与装配意图表达可制造的零件。

outcomes.en: Create a constrained part model and explain a manufacturing choice.
outcomes.zh-CN: 建立带约束的零件模型，并说明制造方案的选择。

evidence.en: A dimensioned drawing and a short assembly or manufacturing note.
evidence.zh-CN: 带尺寸的图纸与简短的装配或制造说明。

summary.en: Read sensors and command an actuator within a measured timing budget.
summary.zh-CN: 在可测量的时序预算内读取传感器并控制执行器。

outcomes.en: Run a feedback loop and identify the effect of sample timing.
outcomes.zh-CN: 运行反馈回路，并识别采样时序的影响。

evidence.en: Firmware and a log of sample intervals, commands and tracking error.
evidence.zh-CN: 固件，以及采样间隔、控制指令和跟踪误差的日志。

summary.en: Combine a motion model and noisy observations to estimate hidden state.
summary.zh-CN: 结合运动模型与含噪观测来估计隐藏状态。

outcomes.en: Implement a small estimator and inspect how uncertainty changes.
outcomes.zh-CN: 实现小型估计器，并观察不确定性如何变化。

evidence.en: Estimated and reference trajectories with residual and uncertainty plots.
evidence.zh-CN: 估计轨迹与参考轨迹，以及残差和不确定性曲线。

summary.en: Search for feasible robot motion under explicit geometric constraints.
summary.zh-CN: 在明确的几何约束下搜索可行的机器人运动。

outcomes.en: Find a collision-free path and explain when the planner can fail.
outcomes.zh-CN: 找到无碰撞路径，并解释规划器可能失败的情形。

evidence.en: A reproducible planning scene with a successful case and a failure case.
evidence.zh-CN: 包含成功与失败案例的可复现规划场景。

summary.en: Extract geometric information from sensor data and test its limitations.
summary.zh-CN: 从传感器数据提取几何信息，并检验其局限。

outcomes.en: Estimate a geometric quantity and inspect sensitivity to calibration.
outcomes.zh-CN: 估计一个几何量，并检查其对标定误差的敏感性。

evidence.en: A small recorded dataset, an estimate and an error analysis.
evidence.zh-CN: 小型记录数据集、估计结果与误差分析。

summary.en: Connect robot modules through documented messages, frames and timing contracts.
summary.zh-CN: 通过文档化的消息、坐标系和时序约定连接机器人模块。

outcomes.en: Connect sensor, estimator and controller modules with traceable data flow.
outcomes.zh-CN: 连接传感器、估计器与控制器模块，并使数据流可追溯。

evidence.en: An interface diagram and a recorded run that can be replayed.
evidence.zh-CN: 接口图，以及能够回放的运行记录。

summary.en: Use a stress comparison to choose and document a CAD fillet.
summary.zh-CN: 利用应力比较来选择并记录 CAD 过渡圆角。

outcomes.en: Compare sharp and rounded transitions under the same load assumptions.
outcomes.zh-CN: 在相同载荷假设下比较尖角与圆角过渡。

evidence.en: Before-and-after CAD views with radius, mesh checks and a design rationale.
evidence.zh-CN: 修改前后的 CAD 视图，注明半径、网格检查与设计依据。

summary.en: Formulate an objective, constraints and numerical checks for a robot problem.
summary.zh-CN: 针对机器人问题定义目标、约束与数值检查。

outcomes.en: Solve a small constrained problem and check the quality of its solution.
outcomes.zh-CN: 求解小型约束问题，并检查解的质量。

evidence.en: An objective definition, solver trace and constraint-residual check.
evidence.zh-CN: 目标函数定义、求解记录与约束残差检查。

summary.en: Combine models into a simulation and document where it diverges from reality.
summary.zh-CN: 将模型组合为仿真系统，并记录其与现实的偏差。

outcomes.en: Compare a simulated behavior with a reference and identify model limitations.
outcomes.zh-CN: 将仿真行为与参考结果比较，并识别模型局限。

evidence.en: A reproducible scenario with parameters, plots and a model-limit note.
evidence.zh-CN: 可复现的场景，附参数、图表与模型局限说明。

summary.en: Demonstrate a robot task while tracing decisions back to models and measurements.
summary.zh-CN: 演示一项机器人任务，并把决策追溯到模型和测量依据。

outcomes.en: Complete a bounded robot task and explain measured success and failure cases.
outcomes.zh-CN: 完成边界明确的机器人任务，并解释测得的成功与失败案例。

evidence.en: A runnable project, demonstration, logs and an account of limitations.
evidence.zh-CN: 可运行项目、演示、日志与局限说明。

summary.en: Explain design choices, results and unresolved questions so others can review them.
summary.zh-CN: 清楚说明设计选择、结果与待解决问题，便于他人评审。

outcomes.en: Present one technical claim with a diagram, evidence and stated limitations.
outcomes.zh-CN: 用图示、证据与局限说明来表达一项技术结论。

evidence.en: A concise report or presentation that a peer can follow and reproduce.
evidence.zh-CN: 一份同行能够理解并复现的简明报告或演示材料。

rationale.en: Matrix calculations provide a small, checkable programming exercise.
rationale.zh-CN: 矩阵计算提供小型、可检验的编程练习。

rationale.en: Frame transformations use vectors and matrices.
rationale.zh-CN: 坐标变换使用向量与矩阵。

rationale.en: Rates of change describe motion and its equations.
rationale.zh-CN: 变化率用于描述运动及其方程。

rationale.en: A plant model gives feedback design a physical interpretation.
rationale.zh-CN: 被控对象模型为反馈设计提供物理解释。

rationale.en: Spatial variation and integration support load and stress reasoning.
rationale.zh-CN: 空间变化与积分为载荷和应力分析提供基础。

rationale.en: Compare stress concentration to justify the transition radius.
rationale.zh-CN: 通过比较应力集中来论证过渡圆角半径。

rationale.en: A constrained CAD part is needed to make and compare the geometric change.
rationale.zh-CN: 需要带约束的 CAD 零件，才能修改并比较几何形状。

rationale.en: The loop needs interpretable sensor readings and actuator interfaces.
rationale.zh-CN: 控制回路需要可解释的传感器读数和执行器接口。

rationale.en: Implement the control law with measured sample timing.
rationale.zh-CN: 按实测采样时序实现控制律。

rationale.en: A control loop requires an executable numerical implementation.
rationale.zh-CN: 控制回路需要可执行的数值实现。

rationale.en: Build and debugging tools support reproducible module integration.
rationale.zh-CN: 构建与调试工具支持可复现的模块集成。

rationale.en: Estimation represents measurement uncertainty with probability.
rationale.zh-CN: 状态估计用概率表达测量不确定性。

rationale.en: Measurements must be interpreted in consistent coordinate frames.
rationale.zh-CN: 需要在一致的坐标系中解释测量值。

rationale.en: Geometric observations must be related across sensor and robot frames.
rationale.zh-CN: 需要关联传感器与机器人坐标系中的几何观测。

rationale.en: Real sensor data exposes calibration and measurement limitations.
rationale.zh-CN: 真实传感器数据可以揭示标定与测量的局限。

rationale.en: Paths and obstacles need a consistent geometric representation.
rationale.zh-CN: 路径与障碍物需要一致的几何表达。

rationale.en: Search and collision checks require executable algorithms.
rationale.zh-CN: 搜索与碰撞检查需要可执行的算法。

rationale.en: Expose estimated state with documented frames and timestamps.
rationale.zh-CN: 通过接口提供状态估计，并记录坐标系和时间戳。

rationale.en: Connect command and feedback interfaces across robot modules.
rationale.zh-CN: 连接机器人各模块的指令与反馈接口。

rationale.en: Objectives and constraints often use vector and matrix operations.
rationale.zh-CN: 目标与约束常使用向量和矩阵运算。

rationale.en: Derivatives describe local changes in the objective.
rationale.zh-CN: 导数描述目标函数的局部变化。

rationale.en: Simulation needs equations that connect forces and motion.
rationale.zh-CN: 仿真需要关联力与运动的方程。

rationale.en: A simulator numerically evaluates the chosen model.
rationale.zh-CN: 仿真器需要数值求解所选模型。

rationale.en: Use a simulated scenario to compare optimized parameters.
rationale.zh-CN: 在仿真场景中比较优化后的参数。

rationale.en: Rehearse task behavior and expose model gaps before integration.
rationale.zh-CN: 在集成前演练任务行为并发现模型差距。

rationale.en: A robot project needs its software modules to communicate.
rationale.zh-CN: 机器人项目需要软件模块互相通信。

rationale.en: A planned motion becomes one capability of the integrated task.
rationale.zh-CN: 规划出的运动成为综合任务中的一项能力。

rationale.en: Observations connect the task to its physical surroundings.
rationale.zh-CN: 观测把任务与物理环境联系起来。

rationale.en: A justified part design connects mechanical decisions to the whole robot.
rationale.zh-CN: 有依据的零件设计将机械决策与整机联系起来。

rationale.en: Explain the evidence and remaining limitations of the completed task.
rationale.zh-CN: 说明已完成任务的证据与剩余局限。
